display_long_description:
# Hands-On! Solitaire – A New Way to Play Klondike Solitaire!

Experience the timeless game of Klondike Solitaire in a whole new dimension! **Hands-On! Solitaire** brings classic solitaire gameplay into **fully immersive VR**, giving you the freedom to naturally **pick up, move, and place cards with your hands**—just like in real life.

## ♦️ **Authentic Klondike Solitaire**
Classic Klondike, just as you remember it—now in VR. Enjoy every flip and win with faithful rules, **natural hand-tracked controls**, and **immersive environments**.[media]

## 👐 **True Hand-Tracking Support**
No controllers needed! **Pick up, move, and place cards with your own hands** using **full hand-tracking** technology. Enjoy intuitive interactions that make every deal and shuffle feel effortless.[media]

## 🌿 **6 Immersive Environments**
Find your perfect atmosphere with **6 beautifully crafted immersive environments**. Whether its flying high above the Grand Canyon or viewing a spectacular Aurora Borealis light show, you can adapt your playing experience to fit your mood.[media]

## 🏡 **Full Passthrough Experience**
Bring solitaire into your own living space! With **full passthrough**, your cards blend seamlessly into your surroundings, making gameplay feel more natural than ever.

What are you waiting for? Step into *Hands-On! Solitaire* and **rediscover the joy of solitaire—completely in virtual reality!**
